policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Use demonstrated_method as initialized from the demonstration at the first decision step, or retained from incoming memory later. Determine current possession from the execution frames only; never treat the demonstration's final hand state as the execution state. A descent to an object, closure to a nonzero opening, and subsequent raised wrist with the opening maintained establish a successful pickup even if the object detector continues reporting the old object location. In these episodes cube grasping leaves about 46% opening, whereas peg grasping leaves about 22–23%; identify the object primarily from the pickup approach rather than these numbers alone. For demonstrated_method="lift", start with D (pick up the cube) when the execution hand is empty. Point at the current cube if a point is required. Once execution shows the cube pickup completed and the hand raised while maintaining its grasp, choose E (place the cube onto the target), pointing at the current target if required. For demonstrated_method="hook", start with A (pick up the peg) when the hand is empty; the peg is the object labeled stick for hooking. Point at that object's current location if required. Once execution shows the peg pickup completed and the wrist raised with its grasp maintained, choose B (hook the cube to the target with the peg). B acts on the current cube toward the current target; if a destination point is required, select the target. For demonstrated_method="push", start with C (close gripper and push the cube to the target), using the current cube and target; if a destination point is required, select the target. Do not insert a pickup for pushing. Use execution-scene coordinates, never demonstration coordinates, and express points as [y, x]. After B, C, or E has visibly delivered the cube to the target, the task is complete and no further manipulation is needed. If queried again before success, apply the same possession-based rules: repeat the method's pickup when empty, or its transport operation when holding the appropriate object. For unclear possession, inspect the entire available execution interval for closure and lift rather than demanding an explicit held label. For any remaining unmatched situation, make a best-effort choice consistent with the retained method: E if holding the cube, B if holding the peg, otherwise its prescribed starting action; with method="unknown", use the same possession rules and default to D when empty.

fields.name: demonstrated_method
fields.description: When memory is empty at the first decision step, classify only the demonstration frames, separately from the reset execution scene. Write "lift" if the hand grasps the cube and raises it before carrying it to the target; write "hook" if the hand grasps and raises the peg before using it to move the cube; write "push" if the closed hand moves the cube at tabletop height without lifting it. Use the complete motion: a momentary 'held' label does not establish lifting, and incidental peg movement does not establish tool use. At every subsequent decision step copy the incoming value unchanged. If demonstration evidence is inconclusive, write "unknown" and retain it. e.g. "hook"
